mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the circulation to the innervated body was worthwhile: the planned insets link tissue exchange and respiratory drive to the larger systems rather than merely joining outlines.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the collecting route to the venous junction felt predictable after the preceding picture had already marked that junction; it added less explanation than the lymph-entry step.

surprise.text: The final comparison clarified that a roughly steady amount of tissue fluid can coexist with continuous filtration and lymph return, rather than requiring fluid movement to stop.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the separate junction and final integration were somewhat mechanical assembly steps.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the system connections and fluid-return comparison made the structures useful to reason about, even if some assembly steps were predictable.
